title: Isolate an unavailable local relay association from independent mailbox listing results
outcome: A missing local-home association is reported truthfully for its mailbox while independently verified available history remains listable, without inventing membership or reconstructing associations.
acceptance: A deterministic injected missing-association case preserves independently available verified mailbox summaries and reports the unavailable mailbox without granting membership, changing its original home or fabricating an empty history.
Behavioral controls cover the refusal/isolation contract and leave participant cursors, receipts and owed notifications unchanged.
